name: OpenAI
summary: OpenAI's models through the Responses API, with an API key.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A model call an agent makes through its route: a person's question to the assistant, or a run of a scheduled agent the Owner enabled. AI proposes; it never writes the books.

base_url.title: API base
base_url.description: The OpenAI API's base, or a data-residency base the organisation's project uses.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Seconds a call may take before it fails over or stops.

auto_qualify.title: Qualify new models automatically
auto_qualify.description: Each model the provider lists for the first time is run through the evals of every agent whose route uses this connection, on synthetic text within the eval runner's budget, and the results appear on the connection (AI-81). Adding it to the allow-list or to a route stays a person's decision.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Retries of a call the provider refused as overloaded or rate limited, with backoff.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.title: API key
secrets.description: An OpenAI project API key, limited to the models it may call.

health_check: Counts the provider's refusals, rate limits and failed connections in recent calls, and the model list's last read.
test_action: Lists the connection's models, then asks the picked model a few tokens of synthetic text and reports what it answered with: its model, its usage and the capabilities it proved.
local_substitute: Recorded answers by default, a developer's own key with FYNIQ_AI_LIVE=1 on the synthetic sample company; a fake Responses API in tests.
